name: shohoz-kitchen
description: Shohoz Kitchen — single-vendor kitchenware store. Next.js storefront + admin (ShohozKitchen_Client) and Express API (ShohozKitchen_Server).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Server install && npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Client install
scripts.dev:api: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Server run start:dev
scripts.dev:web: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Client run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Server run build && npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Client run build
scripts.build:api: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Server run build
scripts.build:web: node init && npm --prefix ShohozKitchen_Client run build
scripts.typecheck: cd ShohozKitchen_Server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../ShohozKitchen_Client && npx tsc --noEmit
